meta.name: paid-ads-integrations
meta.description: Discover, connect, and verify NotFair paid-ad integrations and their actual capabilities. Use when asked to connect an ad account, configure an ads MCP, check available tools, troubleshoot access, or determine whether NotFair can read or change a platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接广告账户并验证集成能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个广告平台的接入与验证。
copy.tagline_en: Connect ad accounts and verify integration capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage ad integrations and need to verify their access.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会先核对可用工具,再验证广告账户的OAuth访问权限,记录平台、账户、可访问日期范围和只读/可写状态;授权失败时给出错误和连接路径,不擅自重试或换账户。
howto.when: 当用户要求连接广告账户、配置广告 MCP、排查访问问题等,或判断 NotFair 能否读写某个平台时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects available tools, verifies OAuth access to ad accounts, and records the platform, account, date range, and read-only or mutation capability. On failure, it reports the error and the connection path without retrying or switching accounts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to connect an ad account, configure an ads MCP, check tools, troubleshoot access, or check if NotFair can read/change a platform.

say_en.note: Claude checks tools and verifies authorization
